what: The PVE page entry through pve-ui-overlays, routes on the TCP 8006 gateway, and the signal, Display1 dialog and terminal policy fixes of exp224-exp229. The repository now also serves pve-ui-overlays 0.1.0, qdev-host and qdev-host-pve 0.4.0.
binaries: The seven QSM debs and three companions installed on 172.16.16.17, 192.168.64.20 and 10.30.0.240, unchanged. See docs/rdp-deployment-exp231-20261108.json.

public_history.how: The same filter as for exp223 (upstream/review-stock4.14-exp231-2026-11-08/public-history-filter.sh). Public main fast-forwards from the exp229 records (e819c40).

checks_before_publication.secrets: All text files and archives of the release, 1448 files: no credentials or keys; the only pattern hit is the TURN config template line in the gateway source. No public node addresses in the evidence.
checks_before_publication.source_against_build: All 1403 files of the build archive identical to public commit 79df885; the public tree has 10 more old review artifacts the build leaves out.
checks_before_publication.tests: Browser bridge 283 and signal/gateway 48 in the isolated build; APT manifest tests on the controller.

checks_after_publication.release_download: All 23 assets identical to the uploaded files; signature and checksums verified with the public key.
checks_after_publication.live_apt: verify.py against the live URL: signed update, all 95 packages downloaded and matched, only 11 allowlisted packages, tampered metadata and a changed deb rejected.
checks_after_publication.nodes: The signed source and pin file (with pve-ui-overlays, qdev-host, qdev-host-pve) configured on all three nodes: installed versions equal the repository candidates, nothing to upgrade.

repositories_made_public: pve-ui-overlays and qdev-host, at the user's word, before this release

not_done.forum: Not posted: the texts are ready (forum-draft.json); the agent has no forum session.

not_done.guests: Guest packages unchanged on the nodes; the exp231 guest debs are built from the exp223 guest source.
